comparison.objective: Polish both faces of a blank on a running buffing wheel without snatch, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous contact-force/orientation control and regrasping around a rotating wheel versus hex-key alignment, collar tuning, counterholding, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Both faces polished without wheel snatch versus two non-bottoming, non-overloaded cycles with low rebound and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve dynamic machinery and damage avoidance, but polishing contact control is meaningfully different from parameter adjustment and impact-response validation. Body/spec details are missing.
